what: Certified lower bound for the topological entropy of the Hénon map x' = 1 − a x² + b y, y' = x (parameters are the exact doubles nearest the stated values). The h-sets are pairwise disjoint parallelograms; each edge [i, j, k] is a covering relation for F^k, verified as strict interval inequalities with outward rounding; relations compose to a common power F^K and the duration-K paths are counted exactly (integer arithmetic, overflow-guarded), so h_top >= ln(path count bound)/K. Consumes one external theorem: covering relations imply semi-conjugacy (Zgliczynski-Gidea).
